_about: Editor's picks of pubs, bars and restaurants added to the smaller city brunch apps. Edit here, then run: python3 city-app-picks/build.py <app-folder> <site-name>. Only list venues you have checked are open. price: 1-4 ($ to $$$$).

items.name: Sips
items.what: Award-winning cocktail bar where drinks are built like recipes, with a theatrical bar counter.

items.name: Paradiso
items.what: Speakeasy hidden behind a fridge door inside a pastrami bar. Inventive, showy cocktails.

items.name: Dry Martini
items.what: Old-school, wood-panelled martini institution with white-jacketed bartenders.

items.name: Boadas
items.what: Barcelona's oldest cocktail bar, open since 1933. Tiny, classic and always lively.

items.name: BierCaB
items.what: Craft beer bar with around thirty rotating taps and good food to match.

items.name: La Cervesera Artesana
items.what: Neighbourhood brewpub brewing since 1996, one of the pioneers of the city's beer scene.

items.name: Cal Pep
items.what: Legendary seafood tapas counter. No printed menu: sit at the bar and let them cook for you.

items.name: Bar Cañete
items.what: Buzzy, classic tapas bar near the Liceu with a long counter and top-quality Spanish produce.

items.name: Can Solé
items.what: Traditional seafood restaurant for paella, fideuà and grilled fish since the early 1900s.

items.name: Disfrutar
items.what: Michelin-starred creative tasting menus. Book well ahead.

items.name: Jigger & Pony
items.what: Polished cocktail bar and a long-time regular on Asia's 50 Best Bars list.

items.name: Atlas
items.what: Grand Art Deco hall with a towering gin collection.

items.name: Native
items.what: Cocktails made with local and regional ingredients, in a cosy shophouse setting.

items.name: Long Bar
items.what: Birthplace of the Singapore Sling, with peanut shells on the floor.

items.name: LeVeL33
items.what: Rooftop microbrewery with house-brewed beers and big Marina Bay views.

items.name: Druggists
items.what: Laid-back craft beer bar with a wall of rotating taps from local and overseas brewers.

items.name: Little Island Brewing Co.
items.what: Seaside brewery and pour-your-own taproom, worth the trip for beer lovers.

items.name: Odette
items.what: Three-Michelin-star modern French dining in the National Gallery. A special-occasion booking.

items.name: Burnt Ends
items.what: Michelin-starred wood-fired barbecue, famously hard to book.

items.name: Candlenut
items.what: Michelin-starred Peranakan cooking, with a generous chef's-choice menu.

items.name: Maxwell Food Centre
items.what: Classic hawker centre, home of the Bib Gourmand Tian Tian Hainanese Chicken Rice.

items.name: Bar Leone
items.what: Roman-style neighbourhood bar named No. 1 in The World's 50 Best Bars 2025. Walk-in only.

items.name: COA
items.what: Agave specialist with a huge mezcal and tequila collection and bright, fresh cocktails.

items.name: Quinary
items.what: Hong Kong's pioneer of molecular mixology. Try the Earl Grey Caviar Martini.

items.name: OZONE
items.what: Sky-high bar with sweeping views over Victoria Harbour.

items.name: The Globe
items.what: Long-running British-style pub with one of the city's best beer ranges and pub classics.

items.name: Ned Kelly's Last Stand
items.what: Aussie pub open since the early 1970s, known for its live jazz band.

items.name: Lung King Heen
items.what: Michelin-starred Cantonese fine dining and dim sum with harbour views.

items.name: Luk Yu Tea House
items.what: Old-world tea house serving dim sum since the 1930s.

items.name: Kam's Roast Goose
items.what: Celebrated roast goose from a family famous for it for generations.

items.name: Tim Ho Wan
items.what: Budget dim sum famous for its baked char siu buns.

sources.label: The Standard: Bar Leone named world's best bar
A Foodie World: best pubs in Hong Kong (2026)

items.name: BKK Social Club
items.what: Glamorous Buenos Aires-inspired cocktail bar, a regular on Asia's 50 Best Bars.

items.name: Lennon's
items.what: 30th-floor vinyl-record bar with thousands of LPs. No. 7 on Asia's 50 Best Bars 2026.

items.name: Vesper
items.what: Elegant, long-standing cocktail bar known for skilled bartenders.

items.name: Sky Bar at lebua
items.what: Famous open-air rooftop bar with dramatic views over the river and skyline.

items.name: Hair of the Dog
items.what: Craft beer bar with one of the city's best tap lists from around the world.

items.name: Sorn
items.what: Three-Michelin-star Southern Thai tasting menu. Book well ahead.

items.name: Le Du
items.what: Michelin-starred modern Thai built on seasonal Thai produce.

items.name: Jay Fai
items.what: Michelin-starred street food, famous for its crab omelette. Expect queues; check it's open before you go.

items.name: Thipsamai
items.what: Bangkok's most famous pad thai shop, serving since the 1960s.

sources.label: Time Out Bangkok: best beer bars

items.name: The Peveril of the Peak
items.what: Tiled, Grade II-listed Victorian boozer, named the UK's best pub by Time Out in 2026.

items.name: The Briton's Protection
items.what: Historic pub dating to 1806, with ornate snug rooms and hundreds of whiskies.

items.name: Sinclair's Oyster Bar
items.what: One of the city's oldest pubs, with a big beer garden and low prices.

items.name: Port Street Beer House
items.what: Craft beer specialist with rotating taps, tap takeovers and quiz nights.

items.name: Schofield's Bar
items.what: Polished cocktail bar run by the Schofield brothers, known for impeccable classics.

items.name: Cloud 23
items.what: Cocktails with a view from the 23rd floor of the Beetham Tower.

items.name: Speak in Code
items.what: Intimate cocktail bar with creative drinks and live music.

items.name: The Morris
items.what: Newer cocktail bar already named in the UK's Top 50 Bars for 2026.

items.name: Mana
items.what: Michelin-starred tasting menus from chef Simon Martin, Manchester's first star in decades.

items.name: Hawksmoor
items.what: Steakhouse serving dry-aged beef from native British breeds.

items.name: Mackie Mayor
items.what: Food hall in a restored Victorian meat market, with independent kitchens and bars.

items.name: Rudy's Pizza
items.what: The original Rudy's: blistered Neapolitan pizza at friendly prices.

sources.label: Taste of Manchester: Peveril crowned UK's best pub
Skiddle: best cocktail bars in Manchester
Michelin Guide: best restaurants in Manchester

items.name: Dante
items.what: Historic café-bar famous for its Negronis and Martinis, a former World's Best Bar.

items.name: Double Chicken Please
items.what: Inventive cocktails that turn famous dishes into drinks. On North America's 50 Best Bars 2026.

items.name: Bemelmans Bar
items.what: Glamorous piano bar with murals by Ludwig Bemelmans and live jazz.

items.name: Employees Only
items.what: Speakeasy-style cocktail bar with late-night food and a loyal following.

items.name: McSorley's Old Ale House
items.what: One of the city's oldest saloons: sawdust floors and two choices, light or dark ale.

items.name: The Dead Rabbit
items.what: Irish taproom and cocktail parlour, once voted the world's best bar. Great Guinness and Irish coffee.

items.name: Paddy Reilly's Music Bar
items.what: Classic Irish pub with live traditional music most nights.

items.name: Katz's Delicatessen
items.what: Lower East Side icon since 1888, famous for hand-cut pastrami on rye.

items.name: Peter Luger
items.what: Old-school steakhouse known for its dry-aged porterhouse since 1887.

items.name: Via Carota
items.what: Hugely popular Italian trattoria, one of the hardest tables in town. Go early.

items.name: Balthazar
items.what: Buzzing French brasserie serving from breakfast until late.

sources.label: Time Out New York: best Irish pubs
Michelin Guide: New York's most iconic restaurants

items.name: The Basketmakers Arms
items.what: Much-loved North Laine backstreet pub, its walls lined with old tins, serving real ales.

items.name: The Robin Hood
items.what: Cosy community pub with armchairs and friendly staff, a past BRAVO best pub winner.

items.name: The Bridge
items.what: Riverside pub on the edge of the River Adur, with garden views and well-reviewed fish and chips.

items.name: The Corner House
items.what: Free house on the site of one of Worthing's oldest pubs.

items.name: The Grand
items.what: Elegant hotel bar, voted best for cocktails at the BRAVO awards 2026.

items.name: Clementine and Co
items.what: Premium spirits and creative seasonal cocktails, with good no- and low-alcohol options.

items.name: Apiary
items.what: Honey-infused cocktails, mead and an organic, biodynamic drinks list.

items.name: Tap House Shoreham
items.what: Relaxed spot for a rotating line-up of craft beers.

items.name: terre à terre
items.what: Inventive vegetarian restaurant, voted Brighton's top restaurant at the BRAVO awards 2026.

items.name: Maré
items.what: Hove's Michelin-starred restaurant, the area's first star in decades.

items.name: Etch
items.what: Chef Steven Edwards' tasting menus in a relaxed Hove dining room.

items.name: Tern
items.what: Worthing's go-to for fine dining, now in a new home on Warwick Street.

sources.label: Neverending Voyage: best restaurants in Worthing
